title: Arizona Oasis Resort Style Estate (Pool, Hot Tub)
description:
This large cul-de-sac home offers endless fun, excitement, and relaxation without ever leaving the property. Here, there is something for everyone. Private Pool, Splash Pad, Hot Tub, 3 Pickleball Courts, Chipping/ Putting Green, Comercial Playground, Outdoor fire pit, 13' Theatre Screen with Surround Sound, and Smart TV's in every bedroom.

 The space 
This large cul-de-sac home offers endless fun, excitement, and relaxation without ever leaving the property. We have something for everyone. 

Pool with water slide, jumping rocks, and a splash pad. 

Sport court with 3 Pickleball courts, full court basketball, tennis, and volleyball. 

Putting green, commercial playground and swing sets.

Enjoy movies and games on the 13 foot projector screen and surround sound. 

Game room with shuffleboard, pool, ping pong, and darts.

This home features an open floor plan and living area, just perfect your next gathering. 
Large open kitchen with two dining areas.
Comfort at every turn including a massage chair, cozy high end beds and a tv in every bedroom.

The fully stocked kitchen has all the gadgets you need to prepare your favorite meals and includes all your basic spices. 

There is a canal that runs directly behind this property which goes for miles in both directions. It’s perfect for jogging, biking, horseback riding, and even fishing. The riparian preserve is also just a short walk and offers ponds as well as miles of hiking and biking trails.

This area is known for its amazing hiking trails, lake access, restaurants, and entertainment but with everything this property offers you may never want to leave the home!

For your security we have cameras around the entire exterior perimeter of the home.

Short term lease required. Parties and events are not allowed. Maximum of 12 people allowed at the property at any one time.

Bedroom 5 is an office/ bedroom combo with inflatable queen size bed (see pictures). Bedroom 6 is a detached structure with a queen size sofa bed (see pictures).
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
Private hot tub - available all year, open 24 hours
Private outdoor pool - open 24 hours, heated, water slide
